scope: Curated knee-research subset; unlisted IonSense resources are not assessed for knee onset
disclaimer: This is a desk audit of source descriptions and publications, not a download-level verification of raw data, knee prevalence or pre-labelled knee onset. Evidence categories are not numeric performance rankings.

definitions.knee_onset: Beginning of detectable nonlinear/accelerating capacity fade under a specified identification method; operational definition varies by paper.
definitions.knee_point: Subsequent transition/inflection or breakpoint marking fast capacity degradation; may not coincide with onset.
definitions.labels: Do not assume knee-onset targets are present because a dataset is used in a knee paper. A derived cycle target must include fitting method, uncertainty and censoring rules.

early-cycle-life.label_status: Derivable using public method; pre-labelled onset targets not confirmed
early-cycle-life.source_review: Original dataset and published knee-identification methodology cross-referenced
early-cycle-life.knee_observed: Published study reports knee-onset and knee-point identification on the underlying capacity curves
early-cycle-life.capacity_resolution: Cycle-level capacity history reported; verify actual per-cell completeness
early-cycle-life.warning: Derivative labels depend on the selected fitting method and cell inclusion; avoid overlapping cell/batch splits.
early-cycle-life.research_use: Primary reproducibility and retrospective onset-label benchmark
early-cycle-life.next_check: Reproduce the published Bacon–Watts fitting protocol and report uncertainty.

samsung-inr18650-30q-knee-point-aging.source_review: Mendeley Data v4 and associated PNAS publication
samsung-inr18650-30q-knee-point-aging.knee_observed: Authors investigate knee points; onset is not verified as a separate supplied annotation
samsung-inr18650-30q-knee-point-aging.capacity_resolution: SOH diagnostic checks every 50–100 cycles before 80% SOH, every 50 cycles thereafter
samsung-inr18650-30q-knee-point-aging.warning: Cycling protocol changes at 80% SOH. A fitted knee could coincide with the protocol boundary rather than reflect solely intrinsic ageing.
samsung-inr18650-30q-knee-point-aging.research_use: Knee-point reference and cautious retrospective onset analysis
samsung-inr18650-30q-knee-point-aging.next_check: Load raw per-cell 0.2C capacity checks and compare knees on both sides of the protocol transition.

chalmers-pybamm-nmc811-cracking-knees.label_status: Explicit knee-forming trajectories; authoritative onset cycle labels not confirmed
chalmers-pybamm-nmc811-cracking-knees.source_review: Mendeley Data v1 and 2024 Journal of Power Sources curvature study
chalmers-pybamm-nmc811-cracking-knees.knee_observed: Cracking-induced knees intentionally simulated and studied
chalmers-pybamm-nmc811-cracking-knees.capacity_resolution: Synthetic cyclic trajectories; verify file-level output sampling
chalmers-pybamm-nmc811-cracking-knees.warning: Only five simulation variants, all based on one parameterized electrochemical cell. Do not count simulated cells as independent experimental validation.
chalmers-pybamm-nmc811-cracking-knees.research_use: Controlled method debugging and mechanism-specific sensitivity checks
chalmers-pybamm-nmc811-cracking-knees.next_check: Check simulated knee timing under the paper's curvature definition and compare with Bacon–Watts.

icformer-two-real-lfp-knee-cells.label_status: Per-cell knee-onset reference labels not confirmed
icformer-two-real-lfp-knee-cells.source_review: Author GitHub repository README and public data-folder description
icformer-two-real-lfp-knee-cells.knee_observed: Two real LFP cell cases described in knee-detection research
icformer-two-real-lfp-knee-cells.capacity_resolution: Incremental-capacity and cycling materials present; check raw file sampling
icformer-two-real-lfp-knee-cells.warning: Only two real test cells. Repository README does not clearly state a reusable data licence; do not treat its synthetic cases as more measured batteries.
icformer-two-real-lfp-knee-cells.research_use: Small illustrative and algorithm sanity-check cases, not a generalization benchmark
icformer-two-real-lfp-knee-cells.next_check: Inspect the two real-cell files, reference cycles and individual file licence conditions.

snu-dynamic-charging-rul-130cells.label_status: Knee-onset labels not reported by source
snu-dynamic-charging-rul-130cells.capacity_resolution: 0.2C diagnostic capacity cycle every 30 cycles; within-cycle current, voltage and capacity sampled every 10 seconds
snu-dynamic-charging-rul-130cells.warning: Randomized charging protocols and mixed chemistry; audit anomalous or incomplete cells and treat unobserved knees as censored.
snu-dynamic-charging-rul-130cells.research_use: Secondary cross-protocol BMS early-warning validation after individual trajectories are screened
snu-dynamic-charging-rul-130cells.next_check: Visualize all 130 cell capacity-check curves and document reproducible knee/no-knee screening.

snu-lg-mj1-spatial-degradation-81cells.label_status: Knee-onset labels not reported by source
snu-lg-mj1-spatial-degradation-81cells.capacity_resolution: Periodic RPT every 100 cycles; capacity-retention values also reported across cycling
snu-lg-mj1-spatial-degradation-81cells.warning: Coarse RPT spacing limits timing precision; source targets anode spatial-degradation diagnosis, not knee prediction.
snu-lg-mj1-spatial-degradation-81cells.research_use: Exploratory cross-chemistry test once actual knee prevalence is established
snu-lg-mj1-spatial-degradation-81cells.next_check: Measure viable cell-specific knee prevalence and label uncertainty bounds.

physics-informed-neural-network-for-lith.label_status: Knee-onset labels not reported by source
physics-informed-neural-network-for-lith.capacity_resolution: 55 NCM cells over six conditions; original cycling telemetry sampled at 1 Hz
physics-informed-neural-network-for-lith.warning: High-frequency telemetry does not itself establish per-cycle knee labels; cell trajectories must be reconstructed and screened.
physics-informed-neural-network-for-lith.research_use: Priority candidate for CQRF extension only after per-cell label qualification
physics-informed-neural-network-for-lith.next_check: Reconstruct full capacity-versus-cycle paths and test stability of knee-onset definitions across protocols.

real-time-personalized-health-status-pre.label_status: Knee-onset labels not reported by source
real-time-personalized-health-status-pre.capacity_resolution: 77 LFP cells at 30°C; identical charge and varied multistage discharge; knee timing resolution not audited
real-time-personalized-health-status-pre.warning: Potentially differing EOL coverage and protocol variation; don't infer onset simply from late-cycle accelerated fade without visual checks.
real-time-personalized-health-status-pre.research_use: Secondary CQRF cross-protocol knee generalization if sufficient knees can be demonstrated
real-time-personalized-health-status-pre.next_check: Audit cycle counts, SOH trajectories and observable-knee prevalence before defining training labels.

batterylife-benchmark.evidence: Aggregated benchmark; knee evidence not audited
batterylife-benchmark.knee_observed: Not established across its constituent sources
batterylife-benchmark.capacity_resolution: Varies by source and standardized version
batterylife-benchmark.warning: Contains overlapping source datasets, including XJTU. Do not combine as independent cohorts or include the same cell in train and test.
batterylife-benchmark.research_use: Possible external multi-source validation after source-level deduplication
batterylife-benchmark.next_check: Map cell IDs to origin datasets, count independent cells and audit per-source knee prevalence.
